measurement: signalling discovery: sender information, receiver information vs scrambled, fitness cost of scrambling
interpretation: Toy-world measurement. 'all_three' means signals carry sender-state information, receivers act on their content and scrambling the content costs fitness here; it is not evidence of language.

receiver_information.needs: excess >= 0.02 bits, p <= 0.01 and >= 0.02 bits above the scrambled run

fitness_cost_of_scrambling.needs: normal - scrambled food energy per agent-tick > 0 over >= 6 paired branches, sign test p <= 0.05
